title.pt-BR: A festa do pijama da Nuna

left.es-MX: Los tres se ponen la pijama.

right.pt-BR: A lebre troca de pelo no inverno.
right.en: The hare changes into a winter coat.
right.es-MX: La liebre cambia su pelaje en invierno.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Lia and Benji pull on cozy pajamas in a bedroom, arms through sleeves; on the right a hare sits in the snow halfway into its thick winter coat, in the same changing pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: an evening sky band across the top, a window and snowy field band through the middle, a bedroom floor band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Os três fazem um ninho de travesseiros.
left.en: The three build a pillow nest.
left.es-MX: Los tres hacen un nido de almohadas.

right.pt-BR: A coelha forra o ninho com pelo.
right.en: The rabbit lines her nest with soft fur.
right.es-MX: La coneja forra su nido con pelo.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Lia and Benji pile pillows and blankets into a big round nest on the floor; on the right a mother rabbit tucks soft fur into a round nest in the grass, in the same nest-building pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a wall band across the top, a grass and pillow band through the middle, a floor band along the bottom.

On the left Lia whispers into Nuna's ear while Benji leans in to listen; on the right two giraffes stand close together under the night sky, heads near each other, in the same leaning-in pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a night sky band across the top, a savanna tree band through the middle, a pillow nest and grass band along the bottom.

On the left Benji lies with his feet up on the pillow and his head at the bottom of the bed while Nuna and Lia giggle; on the right a bat hangs upside down from a branch fast asleep, in the same upside-down pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a night sky band across the top, a branch and headboard band through the middle, a bed band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Os três fazem estrelas no teto.
left.en: The three make stars on the ceiling.
left.es-MX: Los tres hacen estrellas en el techo.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Lia and Benji lie on their backs shining flashlights that make little lights on the ceiling; on the right a field of fireflies blinks on together in the dark forest, in the same twinkling pattern. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a ceiling and night sky band across the top, a forest band through the middle, a bedroom floor band along the bottom.

right.en: The baby orangutan hugs its mom.
right.es-MX: El bebé orangután abraza a su mamá.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Lia and Benji each squeeze a soft stuffed animal in a big hug; on the right a baby orangutan hugs its mother tight on a jungle branch, in the same big hug. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a night sky band across the top, a jungle branch band through the middle, a pillow nest band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Os três dão voltinhas antes de deitar.
left.en: They turn in circles before lying down.
left.es-MX: Los tres dan vueltitas antes de acostarse.

right.pt-BR: O cachorro dá voltas antes de deitar.
right.en: The dog circles before lying down.
right.es-MX: El perro da vueltas antes de acostarse.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Lia and Benji turn in little circles on the pillow nest before flopping down; on the right a dog turns around in a circle on its bed before lying down, in the same circling turn. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a wall band across the top, a dog bed and window band through the middle, a pillow nest band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Benji entra no saco de dormir.
left.en: Benji wiggles into his sleeping bag.
left.es-MX: Benji se mete al saco de dormir.

right.en: The parrotfish sleeps in a bubble blanket.
right.es-MX: El pez loro duerme en su burbuja.

spreads.scene: On the left Benji wiggles into his sleeping bag up to his chin while Nuna and Lia zip theirs; on the right a parrotfish sleeps inside a clear bubble-like cocoon on the reef, in the same snug wrap. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a night water band across the top, a coral reef band through the middle, a sleeping bag band along the bottom.

On the left Nuna, Lia and Benji punch and fluff their pillows with both hands; on the right a kitten kneads a soft cushion with both front paws, in the same pressing pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a wall band across the top, a cushion and window band through the middle, a pillow band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Os três escondem a cabeça na coberta.
left.en: They tuck their heads under the blanket.
left.es-MX: Los tres esconden la cabeza en la cobija.

right.pt-BR: O cisne dorme com a cabeça na asa.
right.en: The swan tucks its head under its wing.
right.es-MX: El cisne esconde la cabeza en el ala.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Lia and Benji pull the blanket over their heads, only a tuft of blanket moving; on the right a swan floats asleep with its head tucked under its wing, in the same tucked-in shape. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a night sky band across the top, a pond band through the middle, a blanket band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Os três dividem uma coberta grande.
left.en: The three share one big blanket.
left.es-MX: Los tres comparten una cobija grande.

right.pt-BR: O lobo cobre o nariz com o rabo.
right.en: The wolf covers its nose with its tail.
right.es-MX: El lobo se tapa con su cola.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Lia and Benji lie close under one big blanket pulled up to their noses; on the right a wolf sleeps curled up in the snow with its bushy tail over its nose, in the same covered-up curl. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a night sky band across the top, a snowy forest band through the middle, a blanket band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Boa noite, Nuna, Lia e Benji.
left.en: Good night, Nuna, Lia and Benji.
left.es-MX: Buenas noches, Nuna, Lia y Benji.

right.pt-BR: O cachalote dorme de pé no mar.
right.en: Sperm whales sleep standing up in the sea.
right.es-MX: El cachalote duerme parado en el mar.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Lia and Benji sleep side by side in a row on the pillow nest; on the right a few sperm whales float upright asleep side by side in the deep sea, in the same row. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Four horizontal bands: a night sky band across the top, a sea surface band, a deep sea band, a pillow nest band along the bottom.

cover_scene: Nuna, Lia, and Benji stand front and center, facing forward, with a hare, a kitten, and a baby orangutan scattered around them, all looking towards the children. The background is composed of three horizontal bands.
